activities.name: Haunted House Soundtrack
activities.tagline: Compose the soundscape for a haunted tour: creaks, whispers, and one big scare.

activities.name: Haunted Hallway Build
activities.tagline: Teams transform one hallway into a silly-spooky walkthrough - designed by kids.

activities.name: Costume Swap Shop
activities.tagline: Outgrown costumes find new kids: the community swap, run like a real shop.

activities.name: Kindness Pumpkins
activities.tagline: Paint kindness pumpkins for neighbors and staff - trick-or-treat in reverse.

activities.name: Pumpkin Bowling
activities.tagline: Mini pumpkins vs. bottle pins: the indoor bowling alley builds itself.

activities.name: Spiderweb Yarn Maze
activities.tagline: Crawl the yarn maze without touching a strand: the quietest challenge indoors.

activities.name: Haunted Lantern Tour
activities.tagline: Lights low, lanterns up: a guided tour of the room's 'haunted' corners.

activities.name: Pumpkin Patch Scavenger Hunt
activities.tagline: Something orange, something round like the moon, one real spider web: go.

activities.name: Leaf Pile Monster Dig
activities.tagline: Bury treasure in the leaf pile, dig like a monster: the fall sensory classic.

activities.name: Ghost Balloon Stomp
activities.tagline: Ghost faces on ankles: stomp others' ghosts while guarding your own.

activities.name: Graveyard Number Dash
activities.tagline: Paper tombstones, called-out math: dash to the right answer.

activities.name: Harvest Moon Journal
activities.tagline: Watch the October moon change night by night: a real sky journal.

activities.name: Pumpkin Life Cycle Wheel
activities.tagline: Spin the paper-plate wheel: seed, sprout, vine, flower, pumpkin.

activities.name: Acorn Cap Witches
activities.tagline: Acorn caps, paint, and pipe cleaners: the tiniest witches in the Vault.

activities.name: Ornament Geometry Stars
activities.tagline: Fold perfect five-point stars from paper strips. Geometry you can hang on a tree.

activities.name: Jingle Bell Rhythm Band
activities.tagline: Wristfuls of jingle bells + a call-and-response beat. The loudest quiet-focus breaker there is.

activities.name: Christmas Light Circuit Cards
activities.tagline: Paper circuits that actually light up, a greeting card with a working bulb.

activities.name: Candy Cane Olympics
activities.tagline: Four ridiculous relay events, one box of candy canes as the equipment.

activities.name: Gumdrop Bridge Build
activities.tagline: Toothpicks and gumdrops, one span to cross. The tastiest engineering constraint there is.

activities.name: Holiday Card Print Shop
activities.tagline: Foam-plate printing: carve once, print a whole stack of cards.

activities.name: Reindeer Relay Race
activities.tagline: Antler headbands, a red nose, and a relay that rewards silliness over speed.

activities.name: Advent Kindness Envelopes
activities.tagline: Twenty-five sealed envelopes, each hiding one small kindness to do that day.

activities.name: Dreidel Spin Physics
activities.tagline: Whose dreidel spins longest? Friction, weight, and surface, a physics lab in a spinning top.

activities.name: Menorah Mosaic Tiles
activities.tagline: Nine branches, hundreds of paper tiles, a mosaic menorah built one square at a time.

activities.name: Hanukkah Story Circle
activities.tagline: The story behind the holiday, told round-robin. Every kid carries one piece of it.

activities.name: Gelt Math Market
activities.tagline: Chocolate coins, real prices, making change, the sweetest math lesson of the year.

activities.name: Blue and White Weaving
activities.tagline: Over-under, over-under, a woven mat in Hanukkah blues, no loom required.

activities.name: Kinara Candle Counting
activities.tagline: Seven candles, three colors, one counting system, the math inside the kinara.

activities.name: Kente Pattern Strips
activities.tagline: Bold color blocks in the kente tradition. Design a strip that means something.

activities.name: Ujima Unity Mural
activities.tagline: One huge mural, every kid holding one section. Ujima means collective work, so the art works collectively.

activities.name: Seven Principles Talk Tokens
activities.tagline: Seven tokens, seven big ideas, the Nguzo Saba as a discussion game, not a lecture.

activities.name: Harvest Bowl Centerpiece
activities.tagline: The mazao: a bowl of harvest fruits and vegetables, arranged like it matters, because it does.

activities.name: Countdown Clock Craft
activities.tagline: A working paper clock with a sweeping second hand. Build the countdown, then run it.

activities.name: Resolution Seed Packets
activities.tagline: Write a resolution, seal it with seeds, plant it in spring. Goals you can water.

activities.name: New Year Noise Parade
activities.tagline: Shakers, drums, and one glorious lap, the new year deserves an entrance.

activities.name: Ball Drop Physics
activities.tagline: Build the Times Square ball at desk scale. Then time its drop to land exactly at zero.

activities.name: Year in Review Comic
activities.tagline: Four panels, one year, the personal highlights reel, drawn not written.

activities.name: Countdown Number Line Hop
activities.tagline: A giant floor number line, ten hops to zero. Subtraction you feel in your legs.

activities.name: Snowflake Symmetry Lab
activities.tagline: No cutting, just looking. Real snowflake photos, and the hunt for six-fold symmetry.

activities.name: Ice Melt Rescue Race
activities.tagline: Small toys frozen in ice blocks. Melt them out with nothing but warm hands and strategy.

activities.name: Winter Bird Feeder
activities.tagline: Pinecones, peanut butter, birdseed, and a week of watching who shows up.

activities.name: Snowy Day Story Walk
activities.tagline: A story in stations: walk the pages, act the weather, end warm inside.

activities.name: Arctic Animal Charades
activities.tagline: Be the polar bear. Be the arctic fox. No talking. The tundra is silent.

activities.name: Winter Solstice Shadow Track
activities.tagline: The shortest day casts the longest shadows. Stake one and watch it move.

activities.name: Rainstick Rhythm Circle
activities.tagline: Build rainsticks, then play the weather, drizzle, rain, storm, calm.

activities.name: Body Percussion Patterns
activities.tagline: Stomp, clap, snap, pat, the instrument you never forget at home.

activities.name: Call and Response Clap
activities.tagline: You clap it, they clap it back, focus training disguised as a game.

activities.name: Found Sound Orchestra
activities.tagline: The classroom is full of instruments. You just have to audition them.

activities.name: Indoor Camping Day
activities.tagline: Blanket forts, flashlight stories, trail mix, camping without the weather.

activities.name: Tape Maze Challenge
activities.tagline: A laser maze made of masking tape, crawl under, step over, don't touch.

activities.name: Balloon Volleyball
activities.tagline: A balloon, a string net, and the longest rallies of your life.

activities.name: Story Building Blocks
activities.tagline: Nine picture dice, one story built block by block, nobody knows the ending.

activities.name: Color Sorting Trays
activities.tagline: Pom-poms, trays, tiny tongs. Sorting practice that feels like play.

activities.name: Big Brush Painting
activities.tagline: Huge paper, huge brushes, huge arm movements, painting at full body scale.

activities.name: Animal Parade March
activities.tagline: Pick an animal, become the animal, march the parade route.

activities.name: Nesting Cup Towers
activities.tagline: Stack them up, knock them down, nest them away, the complete tower lifecycle.

activities.name: Lightning Debates
activities.tagline: Two minutes a side, one judge's rubric, debate club energy with zero prep.

activities.name: Escape Room Build
activities.tagline: Design the locks, hide the clues, then watch another team break out.

activities.name: Mini Podcast Studio
activities.tagline: Plan it, record it, play it back, a three-minute episode with a real audience.

activities.name: Public Art Proposal
activities.tagline: Design the mural, budget the paint, pitch it to the panel. Real-world art, start to finish.

activities.name: Survival Rank Challenge
activities.tagline: Ten items, one desert island, rank them, then see how the experts scored it.

activities.name: Board Game Prototype
activities.tagline: Design it, build it, playtest it. Your game, someone else's table.

activities.name: Peer Skill Swap
activities.tagline: Everyone teaches a five-minute skill. You leave knowing twelve new things.

activities.name: Improv Scene Showdown
activities.tagline: Suggestions in, scenes out, a bracket of improv games with the room as judge.

activities.name: Event Budget Challenge
activities.tagline: Two hundred dollars, one party, zero excuses, plan the whole event on paper and defend every dollar.

activities.name: Photo Story Sequence
activities.tagline: Five photos, one story, no captions allowed until the reveal.

activities.name: Town Hall Simulation
activities.tagline: A real local issue, assigned roles, one gavel, civics with the gloves off (respectfully).

activities.name: Water Filter Build
activities.tagline: Muddy water in, clear water out, engineer a filter from bottles and gravel.

activities.name: Flag Folding Ceremony
activities.tagline: Thirteen folds, each with a meaning. Learn the ceremony the honor guard uses.

activities.name: Parade Route Planners
activities.tagline: Map the parade: scale the route, time the march, beat the road closures.

activities.name: Independence Debate
activities.tagline: 1776, argued fresh. Was independence the right call? You decide, with evidence.

activities.name: Upcycle Invention Challenge
activities.tagline: Trash in, invention out. Build something useful from the recycling bin.

activities.name: Classroom Water Audit
activities.tagline: Where does the water go? Measure it, map it, cut it.

activities.name: Litter Tally Cleanup
activities.tagline: Pick it up, tally it up. A cleanup that ends with real data.

activities.name: Natural Dye Easter Eggs
activities.tagline: Onion skins, turmeric, red cabbage, the pantry dyes eggs better than the kit.

activities.name: Wax-Resist Easter Eggs
activities.tagline: White crayon, bright dye, big reveal. Draw in secret, dye in color.

activities.name: Kindness Egg Missions
activities.tagline: Every egg hides a secret mission, all kindness, zero pranks.

activities.name: Calavera Literaria Poems
activities.tagline: Witty verses about the living, written for the dead. Mexico's playful poetic tradition.

activities.name: Sugar Skull Decorating
activities.tagline: Bright icing, bold patterns, decorate calaveras de azucar the traditional way.

activities.name: Marigold Petal Path
activities.tagline: Lay a path of marigold petals, the traditional welcome for returning spirits.

activities.name: A Dream for Our Community
activities.tagline: Hear Dr. King's dream in his own words, then say yours, one sentence, one drawing, one wall full of them.

activities.name: Floating Ink Ghost
activities.tagline: Draw a ghost with a dry-erase marker, pour water, and watch it lift off the plate and swim.

activities.name: Binary Code Keychain
activities.tagline: Spell your initials in 1s and 0s with two colors of beads. The same code computers actually read.

activities.name: Indigenous Innovators Spotlight
activities.tagline: Real scientists, artists, and astronauts. Research one, make their card, walk the gallery.

activities.name: Feelings Pumpkin Faces
activities.tagline: Draw the feeling on the pumpkin, name it out loud, a feelings check-in disguised as a fall craft.

activities.name: Christmas Light Stencil Art
activities.tagline: Tape a bulb stencil to dark paper, chalk all around it, lift. A glowing string of lights on a night-sky page.

activities.name: Twig Snowflake Craft
activities.tagline: Six sticks, crumpled tissue, and glue. A snowflake you build instead of cutting.

activities.name: CD Rainbow Light Lab
activities.tagline: One old CD, one flashlight, and a white wall. Split plain light into a rainbow and bend it around.

activities.name: A Valentine to a Favorite Book
activities.tagline: Skip the candy hearts. Write a valentine to the book you would hand to a friend today.

activities.name: Lantern Riddle Walk
activities.tagline: Write a riddle, hang it on a lantern, walk the row and solve everyone else's, the Lantern Festival way.

activities.name: Leprechaun Trap Build
activities.tagline: Boxes, ramps, and one gold coin of bait, engineer a trap for a creature who has never once been caught.

activities.name: Shamrock Shapes Hunt
activities.tagline: Green shamrocks are hiding. Each one carries a shape. Find them, sort them, count the haul.

activities.name: Rangoli Pattern Art
activities.tagline: Dot grid, chalk colors, mirror the pattern, floor art that welcomes people in, Diwali-style.

activities.name: Paper Diya Lanterns
activities.tagline: Fold a paper diya, add a battery tealight, and line the windowsill with light, no flames, all glow.

activities.name: Scarf Dance Patterns
activities.tagline: High, low, fast, freeze, follow the pattern with a scarf and feel where the music changes.

activities.name: Freedom Quilt Squares
activities.tagline: One paper square each, a word, a drawing, a fairer world, taped together into one class quilt for MLK Day.

activities.name: Civil Rights Timeline Walk
activities.tagline: Six true events, six stations around the room, walk the movement in order, then rebuild the story from memory.

activities.name: MLK Day Service Sprint
activities.tagline: The holiday is a day on, not a day off. Pick one real job this building needs and finish it in one session.

activities.name: Echoes of a Dream: Choral Reading
activities.tagline: King's cadence, your voices. Echo-read the famous lines together until the room sounds like one speaker.

activities.name: Three Sisters Garden Plan
activities.tagline: Corn holds the beans, beans feed the soil, squash shades the ground, plan the companion garden Indigenous farmers designed.

activities.name: Indigenous Authors Read-Aloud
activities.tagline: Picture books written by Indigenous authors, read aloud properly, then one page of response from every listener.

activities.name: Tribal Nations Map Study
activities.tagline: Whose land is the school on? Find the tribal nations of your region on a real map and learn their names right.

activities.name: Seasonal Rounds Phenology Wheel
activities.tagline: Seasons by what the land is doing, not the calendar. Build a wheel of local plant and animal signs and start watching.

activities.name: Clay Diya Pinch Pots
activities.tagline: Pinch a real clay bowl, paint it bright, set an LED flame inside, a diya made the slow way.

activities.name: Mehndi Paper Patterns
activities.tagline: Fine lines, paisleys, and patience. Practice the pattern language of mehndi on paper hands. No skin, no staining.

activities.name: The Story of the Lights: Ramayana Sequencing
activities.tagline: A prince exiled, a long road home, and lamps lit to guide him. Hear the Diwali story and put its pictures in order.

activities.name: Limerick Writing Circle
activities.tagline: Five lines, two rhymes, one ridiculous ending. Write limericks, the verse form named for a city in Ireland.

activities.name: Walking Rainbow Lab
activities.tagline: Six cups, three colors, paper-towel bridges, the water climbs on its own and mixes a rainbow between the cups.

activities.name: Irish Reel Steps
activities.tagline: Point, hop, travel, learn the first steps of an Irish reel and dance an eight-bar phrase as one group.

activities.name: Tape Path Balance Walk
activities.tagline: Painter's tape on the floor becomes a balance path, straight, zigzag, and curvy lines walked one slow step at a time.

activities.name: Pom-Pom Drop Tubes
activities.tagline: Cardboard tubes taped to a wall, big pom-poms dropped in the top, where did it go? There it is, in the cup.

activities.name: Sponge Squeeze Station
activities.tagline: Two tubs, one sponge, and a fill line to reach, moving water one squeeze at a time is the whole job, and it's enough.

activities.name: Sound-Match Shakers
activities.tagline: Pairs of sealed shakers that sound the same, shake by your ear, walk the rug, and find the one that matches yours.

activities.name: Bubble Wrap Stomp Path
activities.tagline: A taped-down strip of bubble wrap and three ways to cross it: stomp it loud, tiptoe it silent, crawl it popping.

activities.name: Cardboard Tunnel Crawl
activities.tagline: Big boxes taped into a crawl-through tunnel with peek windows, greeters wave from outside, crawlers travel through.

activities.name: Hello Ball Greetings
activities.tagline: Sit in a circle, roll a soft ball to a friend, and say their name out loud. The first icebreaker that works at three.

activities.name: Pouring Practice Trays
activities.tagline: A small pitcher, two cups, and a tray to catch the evidence. Pouring water without flooding the table is a real skill.

activities.name: Nature Color Match Walk
activities.tagline: Three colors on a ring, one short walk. Hold your card against the leaf, the bark, the flower, and call the match.

activities.name: Torn Paper Collage
activities.tagline: No scissors, no lines to follow, tear colored paper with your hands and glue the pieces into a picture only you planned.

activities.name: Red Envelope Wishes
activities.tagline: The real hongbao carries money and luck from elders. The classroom version carries the other half of the custom: a wish.

activities.name: Zodiac Great Race: Story Sequence
activities.tagline: The folk tale of the Jade Emperor's river race, told straight. Then twelve animal cards to put back in finishing order.

activities.name: Kindness Post Office
activities.tagline: A working classroom post office for Valentine's Day, named mailboxes, stamped cards, and a ledger that guarantees nobody gets nothing.

activities.name: Fold-and-Open Symmetry Hearts
activities.tagline: Fold, draw half a heart on the fold, cut, open. The fold did the matching. Symmetry you can hold up to the light.

activities.name: Cardboard Ramp Roll Lab
activities.tagline: One low ramp, three rollers, and the only rule a fair test needs at three: let go, don't push.

activities.name: Hand Lens Look-Closer
activities.tagline: A big magnifying lens turns one leaf, one shell, one scrap of bark into a whole expedition, no collecting, just looking.

activities.name: Pass-It-Down Delivery Line
activities.tagline: A line of hands moves soft picnic things, one at a time, into the basket, every hand touches every delivery.

activities.name: Ring Around the Rosie Circle
activities.tagline: The very old singing circle game: hold hands, walk the ring, sing the short song, and all sit down together on the last line.

activities.name: Pillow Islands
activities.tagline: Flat cushions become islands in a pretend sea, step from island to island, and the floor is the water.

activities.name: Show Me Your Move
activities.tagline: One kid shows one move, a stomp, a wiggle, a face, and the whole circle does it back. That is the entire game.

activities.name: Knee Drum Copycat
activities.tagline: Tap a tiny pattern on your knees, one, two, or three taps, and the circle taps it straight back.

activities.name: Texture Touch Basket Walk
activities.tagline: A short walk with empty baskets and one job for small hands: find something rough, something smooth, something soft.

activities.name: Big Dot Sticker Pictures
activities.tagline: Peel a big dot sticker, place it where you want it. The pincer practice that comes before scissors, pens, and everything else.

activities.name: Pool Noodle Rope Threading
activities.tagline: Big soft rings of pool noodle, one thick rope, thread them on, slide them down, pull them off, start again.

activities.name: Jump the River Ropes
activities.tagline: Two ropes on the ground make a river. Stand at the bank, jump with two feet, land on the other side.

activities.name: Blanket Fort Book Nook
activities.tagline: An adult-built blanket fort, a small pile of picture books, and room inside for three readers at a time.

activities.name: Morse Code Signal Post
activities.tagline: Dots and dashes sent by flashlight and table-tap. Learn SOS, signal your initials, and run a message post across the room.

activities.name: Soft Ball New Year Drop
activities.tagline: Count five down to one on your fingers, and the grown-up drops one big soft ball into the basket. That is the whole New Year party at three.

activities.name: Big Egg Roll on the Slope
activities.tagline: The old Easter egg roll, sized for three: one big egg, one gentle grass slope, roll it down, walk down, roll it again.

activities.name: First Puddle Walk
activities.tagline: Boots on, and a slow walk through the shallow puddles after rain, first round walking only, and the splash is saved for last.

activities.name: Cup of Snow Melting Watch
activities.tagline: One clear cup of real snow, brought inside and watched: it goes down, the water comes up, and nobody touches it. Waiting is the activity.

activities.name: Cushion Train All Aboard
activities.tagline: A row of cushions and chairs becomes a train: a ticket block to hand the driver, stops the kids name, and everyone rides.

activities.name: Box Boat Row Along
activities.tagline: One big cardboard box is the boat: sit inside, row with your arms to a slow song, and dock at the cushion island when the song ends.

activities.name: Wide Plank Bridge Crossing
activities.tagline: Two low stacks of big blocks, one wide plank across, and a soft toy that walks the bridge, the first bridge a three-year-old can build.

activities.name: Blanket Ball Bounce Together
activities.tagline: Everyone holds the edge of one blanket, one soft ball rolls in the middle, and the whole group's job is the same: keep it on, keep it low.

activities.name: Animal Sound Find Your Pair
activities.tagline: Deal a big animal card to every kid. Somebody else has your same animal. Make the sound, wander, and find them.

activities.name: Chalk Arrow Trail
activities.tagline: Big chalk arrows on the ground, one after another, and a whole trail to follow, point where each arrow points, then walk that way.

activities.name: Loud Quiet Song Switch
activities.tagline: One song everyone knows, sung whole, but when the grown-up's hands go up it is loud, and when they come down it is quiet.

activities.name: Two Foot Landing Pads
activities.tagline: Foam pads on the floor and one job: jump with two feet, land with two feet, and stick it for a count of three.

activities.name: Lantern Carry Parade
activities.tagline: A made lantern with a safe light inside, carried with two hands on a slow walk around the room, the Lantern Festival, sized for three.

activities.name: Eight Lights Line Up
activities.tagline: Eight LED lights in a row, put on one at a time and counted as they go. The Hanukkah lights, at a three-year-old's pace.

activities.name: Wind Ribbon Watch
activities.tagline: Ribbons tied along a fence by a grown-up, and one job: watch them, point when a gust comes, and say which way the wind is pushing.

activities.name: Boot Print Snow Trail
activities.tagline: Fresh snow, one short walk, and your own boot prints behind you: walk out, turn around, count your steps back along your own trail.

activities.name: Paper Puddle Stepping
activities.tagline: Big blue paper puddles on the floor indoors, and the rule is the good one: step IN every puddle. Dry feet, wet pretend.

activities.name: Big Tongs Ice Move
activities.tagline: Big serving tongs, big ice cubes, one tray to another: grip one, carry it, drop it in, count it. Cold hands, careful work.

activities.name: Pan Balance Heavy Light
activities.tagline: A two-pan balance and big things to test: one thing per side, watch which side goes down. That side is carrying the heavier one.

activities.name: Toy Wagon Pull Together
activities.tagline: A small wagon, a load of soft toys, and a blanket across the room: two pullers, one slow trip, every toy delivered together.

activities.name: Teddy Says My Name
activities.tagline: Every kid holds a soft toy, and the toy does the introducing: its name, your name, and one thing you love. Shy voices welcome. Teddies are brave.

activities.name: Find a Friend Wearing
activities.tagline: The grown-up holds up one big colour card. Somewhere in the circle, somebody is wearing that colour. Go and stand with them, and wave.

activities.name: Watering Can Plant Round
activities.tagline: One small watering can, half full, carried with two hands to the real plants: pour slowly, empty it, and the plants have been watered by you.

activities.name: Lullaby Rock and Sway
activities.tagline: A soft doll in your arms and one slow song from the whole group: rock side to side in time, and when the song ends, the baby is asleep.

activities.name: Felt Tree, One by One
activities.tagline: A big felt tree low on the wall and big soft pieces to press onto it, one kid, one piece, one at a time, a first tree to decorate.

activities.name: Sun Patch, Shade Patch
activities.tagline: A sunny patch and a shady patch side by side, and one job: stand in each one and feel the difference on your own hands.

activities.name: Rain Call: To the Rug
activities.tagline: The grown-up raises an umbrella and shakes the rain sound, rain! Everyone walks to the rug and crouches down dry until the sun comes back.

activities.name: Window Raindrop Follow
activities.tagline: Real rain on a real window: pick one drop at the top, put your finger beside it on the glass, and follow it all the way down.

activities.name: Big Magnet Wand: It Sticks
activities.tagline: One big magnet wand and a tray of big things: touch each one and find out. It sticks, or it doesn't. Your hand is the lab.

activities.name: Blanket Carry: Teddy to Bed
activities.tagline: Two carriers, one small blanket held low, and a big teddy who is very nearly asleep: walk him to his bed without waking him.

activities.name: Name Echo, Two Claps
activities.tagline: Say your name. The whole circle says it right back, just like you said it, then two claps, together, like a small drum answering.

activities.name: Dandelion Clock Blow Walk
activities.tagline: A slow walk to find a ripe dandelion clock: hold it low, blow, and count your puffs while the seeds float away like tiny parachutes.

activities.name: One Shake, Pass It Around
activities.tagline: One tambourine for the whole circle. When it reaches you: one shake, a real one, then pass it on. The music is taking turns.

activities.name: Sticky Window Big Shapes
activities.tagline: Clear sticky film on a low window, sticky side out, and big shapes to press on with a whole palm. A picture you can move all day.

activities.name: Grass Hill Roll Down
activities.tagline: A gentle grass slope, arms hugged tight, and the oldest ride there is: lie down sideways at the top and roll, all the way to the bottom.

activities.name: Big Lid Match Basket
activities.tagline: A basket of big lids and the pots they belong to: try a lid, feel if it fits, twist or press. A covered pot is a finished job.

activities.name: Big Heart Hand Delivery
activities.tagline: One big paper heart, carried in two hands across the room and handed to one named friend, a valentine delivered by hand, at walking pace.

activities.name: One Branch Bud Count
activities.tagline: One low branch in spring, and its buds counted one by one with a fingertip, touch a bud, say a number, because the buds are counting on growing.

activities.name: Big Pot Stir-Together
activities.tagline: One big empty pot, one long spoon passed hand to hand: everyone adds one pretend thing and stirs it in. Rainy-day soup, made of turns.

activities.name: Rain Drums on Pots
activities.tagline: Upturned pots and fingertips: drizzle is a patter, a downpour is a rumble, the rain outside, played on the kitchen shelf.

activities.name: Big Funnel Sand Pour
activities.tagline: A big funnel in a bottle, a cup of dry sand, and a stream that pours, narrows and fills, watch the level climb from the bottom up.

activities.name: Long Banner Carry-Together
activities.tagline: A long paper banner and a hand every few steps along its edge: the whole crew walks it across the room flat, or it does not arrive at all.

activities.name: How I Got Here Moves
activities.tagline: Tell the group how you travel, feet, wheels, bus, car, and everyone copies the movement: marching feet, steering hands, a gentle bus bounce.

activities.name: Big Tree Hug and Listen
activities.tagline: One big tree, arms around it or palms flat on the bark, and a whole quiet minute of listening to what a tree's place sounds like.

activities.name: Sing It Back: Echo Lines
activities.tagline: The grown-up sings one short line of a song everybody knows, and the whole group sings it right back, same tune, like the song answering itself.

activities.name: Paint the Big Box House
activities.tagline: A cardboard box big enough to stand inside, washable paint and brushes as big as your hand: the group paints its house, outside and in, then lives in it.

activities.name: Giant Steps, Baby Steps
activities.tagline: The caller names a step, a GIANT step, a baby step, a marching step, and the whole group takes it together, all the way to the garden gate.

activities.name: Sock Pair Match Basket
activities.tagline: A basket of big clean odd socks: find the two that match, same colour, same stripes, same size, and roll each pair into a ball. Real laundry, real quiet.

activities.name: Paper Diya Welcome Row
activities.tagline: Big paper diya lamps carried in two hands and set along a floor path, each one lit as it lands. A welcome written in light, one lamp at a time.

activities.name: Roll It Bigger Snowball
activities.tagline: One small snowball, rolled along the snow by many mittens: it picks up snow as it goes and grows. Everybody can feel it getting heavier.

activities.name: Big Tape Roads Car Town
activities.tagline: Painter's tape roads laid straight across the floor, and big chunky cars to drive them: the town is built first, then driven, stop by stop.

activities.name: Fog Window Finger Drawing
activities.tagline: The grown-up mists the window until it fogs, and one finger draws a sun, a face, a wobbly house. Then the fog fades and takes every mark with it.

activities.name: Big Shadow Grow and Shrink
activities.tagline: One big cardboard shape, one lamp, one wall: move the shape nearer the light and its shadow grows, the group directs, the shadow obeys.

activities.name: Sponge Pass: Fill the Pot
activities.tagline: One soaked sponge passed hand to hand down the whole line, and a squeeze over the pot at the end: the line's job is measured in what arrives still wet.

activities.name: Show Me Three Fingers
activities.tagline: Everybody in this room is three, so everybody learns the hard, proud trick of holding up three fingers, and the whole circle copies yours.

activities.name: After-Rain Worm Count
activities.tagline: After rain, the worms come up onto the path: the group counts them where they lie, steps carefully round them, and touches not one.

activities.name: Feel the Beat: Heart Tap
activities.tagline: March in place until your heart goes fast, hand flat on your chest to feel it, then tap that beat on your knees, and tap it again slower after the rest.

activities.name: Big Sponge Stamp Mural
activities.tagline: Chunky sponge shapes dipped in paint and pressed straight down on one long shared sheet: print, lift, look, a mural built one honest print at a time.

activities.name: Big Ball Kick to the Wall
activities.tagline: One big light ball, one kicker at a time, one wall: walk up, plant your feet, swing your leg, and the wall stops it and sends the next turn back.

activities.name: Big Zip Up-and-Down Board
activities.tagline: One chunky zip on a sturdy board: grip the big pull, slide it up slow, slide it down slow. A coat's hardest job, practised where no coat is waiting.

activities.name: Big Gold Coin Pot Carry
activities.tagline: Palm-sized pretend gold coins carried in two hands, one at a time, and dropped into the big pot with a clink. The whole group's carrying, collected.

activities.name: First Firefly Blink Count
activities.tagline: Out at dusk on a summer evening: fireflies blink over the grass and the group counts the blinks together. Catching nothing, just counting light.

activities.name: Big Pillow Mountain Climb
activities.tagline: A mountain of big soft pillows built by the grown-up: hands and knees up one side, a sit at the top, hands and knees down the other, one climber at a time.

activities.name: Blanket Sled Slow Pull
activities.tagline: One big blanket on a smooth floor, one seated rider holding its edges, and the grown-up pulling slow and straight, an indoor sled ride at walking pace.

activities.name: Big Smell Jar: Sniff and Say
activities.tagline: Big jars with one honest smell each, orange peel, cinnamon, fresh mint: lid off, one sniff, and say what your nose found. Nothing to guess, nothing to win.

activities.name: Big Felt Quilt Wall Build
activities.tagline: Hand-sized felt squares carried one at a time to a big wall board and pressed edge to edge. A quilt the whole crew builds standing up, square by square.

activities.name: Big Hat Pass and Say
activities.tagline: One big soft hat travels hand to hand while the grown-up sings; when the song stops, whoever holds it puts it on and says their name and one favourite thing.

activities.name: Big Texture Feet Path Walk
activities.tagline: A short path of big panels, grass, a smooth mat, sand in a tray, a soft towel: walked slowly, one panel at a time, and every panel reported in foot words.

activities.name: Big Pot Lid Cymbal Band
activities.tagline: Two big pot lids per musician, crashed together only when the conductor's hands go UP, and the band's real skill is the silence when they come DOWN.

activities.name: Big Finger Paint Sky Sheet
activities.tagline: One very long sheet, two blues, and nothing but fingers: the whole group paints one shared sky, then dabs the clouds in white with their fingertips.

activities.name: Big Beanbag Balance Walk
activities.tagline: A big soft beanbag balanced on your head, a short line to walk, and the slowest feet in the room: if it falls, you pick it up, put it back, and walk on.

activities.name: Big Peg Clip Card Row
activities.tagline: Chunky pegs squeezed open and clipped along one thick card's edge, one by one: squeeze, clip, let go, a whole row of pegs standing at attention.

activities.name: Big Ribbon Wand Parade Walk
activities.tagline: A big ribbon wand in each hand and a slow walking loop: the whole parade waves red, white, and blue for the country's birthday.

activities.name: One Tree Autumn Colour Count
activities.tagline: One autumn tree, counted colour by colour with pointing fingers: how many colours is one tree wearing this week?

activities.name: Umbrella Drip Count: Listen
activities.tagline: The grown-up makes rain on a big umbrella indoors; it runs off the edge in drips, and the group counts the drips by ear as they land.

activities.name: Big Cotton Cloud Blanket Drift
activities.tagline: Big soft white puffs drift on a blanket the whole crew holds low, waved slow as weather: keep the clouds moving, never bouncing, never rushed.

activities.name: Big Float-Sink Basin Sort
activities.tagline: One big basin, one big object at a time: held over the water, let go, and the basin itself reports, floats or sinks, for the group to sort by.

activities.name: Big Picnic Blanket Set-Together
activities.tagline: The crew carries one big blanket in together, spreads it flat, and sets a pretend picnic plate by plate, every place laid by a different pair of hands.

activities.name: Big Feelings Card Show and Say
activities.tagline: One big feelings card at a time, drawn and held high: name the feeling, try the face, and the whole circle tries it back. Every feeling a right answer.

activities.name: Big Ant Trail Count Watch
activities.tagline: A real ant trail, watched from behind the watching line: ants cross one leaf on their own road, and the group counts the crossings to ten, again and again.

activities.name: Big Chime Note, When Pointed
activities.tagline: One big chime bar each, struck once and only when the pointer lands on you: eight separate notes, waited for, become a scale the room plays together.

activities.name: Big Handprint Leaf Tree
activities.tagline: One painted palm print each, pressed once onto a big bare tree poster: a tree whose leaves are the group's own hands, every leaf named.

activities.name: Big Feather Blow and Float
activities.tagline: One big feather over the circle, kept in the air by breath alone: blow when it drifts to you, watch when it doesn't, a whole game at floating speed.

activities.name: Big Button Slot Drop Box
activities.tagline: Palm-sized buttons, one wide slot in a box lid: hold flat, hover, let go, and listen for the landing. Then shake the box and hear how many you made.

activities.name: Big Dream Echo Circle
activities.tagline: One short dream sentence, said by the grown-up and echoed whole by the circle: on Dr. King's day, everybody's dream gets said out loud.

activities.name: Big Warm Stone Hold and Tell
activities.tagline: Two big smooth stones, one sun-warmed and one shade-cool, held one in each hand: which hand is holding summer? Palms report, words follow.

activities.name: Big Bus Stop Ride-Along
activities.tagline: A row of chairs is the bus and it never moves an inch: the driver calls the stops, riders pay one big token, ride, and get off at their stop.

activities.name: Big Leg Tunnel Ball Roll
activities.tagline: The group stands in two facing lines, legs wide: a tunnel made of people. One big ball rolls its whole length, in one end, out the other, to cheers.

activities.name: Big Heavy-Light Hand Balance
activities.tagline: One object in each hand, arms out like a scale: which hand sinks? The body's own balance reports heavy and light, no scale required.

activities.name: Big One Statue, Many Bodies
activities.tagline: The whole group builds ONE statue together, an arm here, a crouch there, then everybody freezes at once and the statue stands, breathing quietly.

activities.name: Big Pass the Smile Circle
activities.tagline: One smile, passed neighbour to neighbour round the whole circle: turn, smile at the next face, and watch your smile travel all the way home.

activities.name: Big Puddle Sky Mirror Look
activities.tagline: A still puddle after rain is holding a picture of the sky. The group gathers round its edge and looks IN, clouds, blue, and their own faces, upside down.

activities.name: Big Rainstick Tip and Listen
activities.tagline: One big rainstick, tipped so slowly the rain inside takes a whole minute to fall: the holder tips, the whole circle listens to weather only hands can make.

activities.name: Big Bubble Wrap Print Painting
activities.tagline: A sheet of big-bubble wrap is the printing press: painted, pressed flat onto big paper, lifted straight, a page of circles, stamped by the sheet itself.

activities.name: Big Log Roll Down the Mat
activities.tagline: One long mat, one straight line: lie down at the end, arms in like a log, and roll the whole length without once sitting up. Rolling IS the travelling.

activities.name: Big Wooden Bead Stringing
activities.tagline: Big wooden beads and one stiff lace with a taped end: find a bead, aim the lace at its hole, push it home. A string that grows one bead at a time.

activities.name: Big Story Stone, First People
activities.tagline: One smooth stone passed hand to hand in the story circle: today the grown-up tells, plainly and truly, whose land this classroom stands on.

activities.name: Big Leaf Light Window Hold
activities.tagline: One big spring leaf, chosen by its holder and lifted to the light: the sun shines clean through it, and its veins stand up like a tiny map.

activities.name: Big Tissue Snow, Gentle Fall
activities.tagline: One white tissue at a time, dropped from high hands over the rug: it does not fall, it FLOATS, and the whole room practises being gentle enough to watch.

activities.name: Big Float or Sink, First Dip
activities.tagline: A tub of water and a shelf of big things: each one is held over the water, dipped once, and reported in the session's only two words. FLOAT or SINK.

activities.name: Big Warm Hand, Lend a Hand
activities.tagline: Two hands meet palm to palm, one warm from rubbing, one cool from waiting, and the pair stays together until both hands agree: WARM NOW.

activities.name: Big Find the Matching Sock Pair
activities.tagline: One big sock is held up for the whole circle: somewhere in the small soft pile is its ONE partner. Whoever finds it holds up a pair, and pairs get cheered.

activities.name: Big Paper Fan Wind Maker
activities.tagline: One big stiff paper fan per wind maker: flap it slow, flap it fast, and feel the wind you made arrive on your own face, weather, by hand.

activities.name: Big Name Bell, Ring for You
activities.tagline: One good bell with a clear voice. The bell keeper rings it for ONE name at a time, and the named child answers, in any way at all, when their name is rung.

activities.name: Big Shoe Stomp Marching Band
activities.tagline: Shoes are the drums and the spot is the stage: the band marches on the spot, shakers in hand, and stops dead when the conductor's hand goes up.

activities.name: Big Tear and Stick Paper Mosaic
activities.tagline: No scissors, no copying: big soft paper torn by hand into palm-sized pieces, stuck inside one huge shared sun until the whole outline glows.

activities.name: Big Ribbon Wand River Dance
activities.tagline: One ribbon wand per dancer, one slow piece of music: the ribbon draws a river in the air, wide bends, slow falls, and rests when the music rests.

activities.name: Big Cushion Bridge Crossing
activities.tagline: A line of big floor cushions is the bridge over the pretend river rug: cross it one slow step at a time, with a hand offered. Arriving is the whole course.

activities.name: Big Earth Day First Garden Promise
activities.tagline: One real plant, one small cup of water per child, poured slowly, and a smooth promise stone set beside it: today we look after something that grows.

activities.name: Big Sprinkler Rainbow Edge Walk
activities.tagline: A garden sprinkler on a sunny morning: stand at the edge of its mist, watch for the rainbow it sometimes keeps, and take one slow walk through the edge.

activities.name: Big Hide the Bear, Seek Together
activities.tagline: One big soft bear hides somewhere in the room, not too well. The whole group seeks together, and the finding belongs to everybody.

activities.name: Big Cardboard Brick Wall Build
activities.tagline: Bricks as big as pillows, light as boxes: build a wall as high as your chin, report on it honestly, and when it falls, that is data too.

activities.name: Big Laundry Line, Helping Hands
activities.tagline: The room's pretend washing needs doing: pairs of carriers take one big cloth at a time to the low line and peg it up together until the whole wash waves.

activities.name: Big Mirror Face, Copy My Face
activities.tagline: Two partners sit face to face. One makes a face, any face at all. The other copies it, like a mirror that is also a friend.

activities.name: Big Cloud Lying, Picture Names
activities.tagline: One big blanket on the grass, the whole group on its back, eyes up: every cloud is being something today, and the group's job is to say what.

activities.name: Big Water Painting, Fence Picture
activities.tagline: Big brushes, buckets of plain water, the fence for a canvas: paint any picture. It shines dark, dries, disappears, and the fence is ready again.

activities.name: Big Beach Ball, Keep It Floating
activities.tagline: The whole circle sits down, hands up: one big soft beach ball is tapped gently into the air, and the circle's one job is to not let it come home to the floor.

activities.name: Big Belly Buddy Breathing Watch
activities.tagline: Lie down, set one small soft buddy on your belly, and watch it ride: up when the breath comes in, down when the breath goes out. That is the whole watch.

activities.name: Big Echo Drum, One Hit Back
activities.tagline: One big drum voice at a time: the adult hits the drum ONCE, and the whole circle hits once back, an echo with hands, and the listening in between.

activities.name: Big Humming Lullaby, Bear Sleep
activities.tagline: One very sleepy bear, one soft tune with no words: the whole circle hums it together, rocking gently, until the bear is, officially, ceremonially, asleep.

activities.name: Big Groundhog Shadow Morning Look
activities.tagline: February the second: a soft groundhog peeks out of its burrow box, and the whole group checks the sunny patch. Is anybody's shadow out today?

activities.name: Big New Friend Room Tour
activities.tagline: A new friend needs three places first: where the cups live, where the coats hang, and where the quiet is. The group shows all three, pointing and naming.

activities.name: Big Sandcastle, One Bucket Towers
activities.tagline: Wet sand, one big bucket, pat-pat-turn: a tower stands. Dry sand runs through your fingers. Wet sand stands up. That is the whole summer science, built.

activities.name: Big Sound Jar, Loud or Soft
activities.tagline: Big sealed jars, one shake each: some jars are LOUD and some are SOFT, and the ears of the room file every one on its right mat.

activities.name: Big Choose Your Colour Corner
activities.tagline: Four big colours, one in each corner. Walk to the colour you like best today, stand with your colour, and wave to the other corners. Tomorrow may differ.

activities.name: Big Mud Pie Bakery Morning
activities.tagline: Real mud, big tins, fallen petals for decoration: the bakery opens, the pies are mixed to pie-thickness, served on leaf plates, and never, ever eaten.

activities.name: Adopt-a-Tree Year Log
activities.tagline: One tree, adopted for a whole year: measured monthly, watched through every season, and handed on to next year's custodians with its log.

activities.name: Seed Library Opening Day
activities.tagline: A real lending library of seeds: every packet germination-tested, honestly labelled, and lent out on a ledger the teen librarians keep.

activities.name: Compass Course, Three Flags
activities.tagline: Real bearings, counted paces, three flags to find: teen teams set an orienteering course, then run each other's, navigation, not wandering.

activities.name: Referee-Run Round Robin
activities.tagline: Teens officiate their own tournament: whistles, scoresheets, a dispute protocol, and a rotation where everybody referees and everybody plays.

activities.name: Ten-Minute Set, Clean Handover
activities.tagline: Teen DJs each play a short set and hand the floor to the next DJ without a gap, a clash, or a dead second. The join is the skill.

activities.name: Indoor Clue Chain Architects
activities.tagline: Teams design a chain of sealed clues that leads somewhere real. Then watch, silent, while another team runs it and finds every weak link.

activities.name: Hot Seat, Kind Questions
activities.tagline: One chair, the whole group's kind attention, and questions screened in advance. The seat is warm, never hot, and the pass is absolute.

activities.name: Repair Cafe, First Session
activities.tagline: Teens run a working repair cafe: triage, mending benches, honest verdicts, and owners who leave with fixed things and real explanations.

activities.name: Midnight Around the World
activities.tagline: One hosted evening that follows midnight across the time zones: live arithmetic, a wall map, and each city greeted properly as its year turns.

activities.name: Wind Turbine Blade Trials
activities.tagline: One fan, one hub, many blades: change a single variable at a time and let two honest measures, revolutions and lifted clips, judge every design.

activities.name: Commonplace Book, First Pages
activities.tagline: Other people's best sentences, copied by hand into a book that is yours: a centuries-old way to build a mind, and an index that argues back.

activities.name: Teach-Back to the Youngers
activities.tagline: Teens prepare and deliver a real ten-minute session for younger children: rehearsed, supervised, and marked only by the youngers' attention.

activities.name: Compost Heap Temperature Ledger
activities.tagline: A working compost heap run by teens: built in layers, turned on a rota, and read weekly by thermometer. The heat is the evidence it is alive.

activities.name: First Frost Forecast Desk
activities.tagline: Teens run a frost forecast for real gardeners: evening readings, a signed prediction, and a morning check that grades it honestly.

activities.name: Summer Glut Preserving Day
activities.tagline: A glut becomes jars: teens wash, chop, pack and label under one tested recipe followed exactly, while the adult runs the processing, summer, kept.

activities.name: Trail Crew, First Pass
activities.tagline: Teens maintain a real path under permission: drainage cleared, waymarks renewed, and every stretch of work logged in the crew book.

activities.name: Star Party Hosts
activities.tagline: Teens host a stargazing evening for families: red-light discipline, a rehearsed sky tour, and the old stories told as stories under the things themselves.

activities.name: Stream Watch Testing Round
activities.tagline: Teens test a real stream, its temperature, its clarity, and the small creatures whose presence grades water, and file the round's evidence.

activities.name: Circuit Course, Designed and Coached
activities.tagline: Teens design a circuit of stations, test every station on themselves, then coach it for their peers. Design is the workout before the workout.

activities.name: New Game Playtest League
activities.tagline: Teams invent a movement game, write its rules, watch strangers break them, revise, and republish, the league rewards the clearest game, not the loudest.

activities.name: Cold Stratification Seed Bank
activities.tagline: Teens give native seeds the winter they require: labelled jars of cold, damp weeks, logged chill, and a spring germination test that grades the bank.

activities.name: Transect Line Field Survey
activities.tagline: Teens survey one fixed line across real ground. Quadrats at set intervals, every plant and surface recorded square by square, season after season.

activities.name: Long Rope Turning Crew
activities.tagline: Two turners, one long rope, a whole crew jumping in turn: turning is the skilled job, entries are timed to a moving rope, and nobody jumps alone.

activities.name: Part-Singing Choir, First Rehearsals
activities.tagline: Teens form a choir that sings in parts: sections, blending, a conductor's beat shared in rotation, two lines held at once, by listening.

activities.name: Foley Radio Play, Recorded Live
activities.tagline: A scripted radio drama performed entire on a rainy day: actors at the microphone, live sound effects made by hand at the Foley table, one take per scene.

activities.name: Partner Portrait Interviews
activities.tagline: One deep interview per pair, notes kept, and then the introduction nobody else could give: you present the partner you actually met.

activities.name: One-Sheet Zine Workshop
activities.tagline: Eight pages from a single folded sheet: teens plan, sequence, letter and trade a finished zine, a whole publication with no editor but its maker.

activities.name: Lunar New Year Dumpling Folding Night
activities.tagline: Teens host a dumpling night for the new year: folds sealed with water and patience, counted by the tray. The adult runs the steamer, the crew folds.

activities.name: Overwintering Garlic Planting Crew
activities.tagline: Teens plant garlic in autumn for a summer harvest: cloves set pointed-up under mulch, the winter logged honestly, spring emergence counted shoot by shoot.

activities.name: Dusk Bat Exit Count
activities.tagline: Teens count bats leaving a known roost at dusk from one set watch point: sectors, silence, tallies by the minute, and no bat ever approached or handled.

activities.name: Tchoukball First Session
activities.tagline: A no-contact team game where shots rebound off a frame and points are scored by where the ball lands: catching, not colliding, wins the ground.

activities.name: Song Arranging Studio, First Session
activities.tagline: Teens take one permitted song apart, melody, chords, structure, and rebuild it in a new arrangement the whole room rehearses and logs.

activities.name: One-Room Documentary Crew
activities.tagline: On a rainy day, a teen crew films a short documentary about one real room: consent first, interviews on the record, and a cut planned before it is shot.

activities.name: Spectrum Line Introductions
activities.tagline: New teens answer screened, low-stakes statements with their feet first. Stand somewhere on the line, then talk to the person furthest from your spot.

activities.name: Pamphlet-Stitch Bookbinding Studio
activities.tagline: Teens bind a real blank book by hand: folded signatures, a stitched spine, covers cut true. A book is a machine you can make at one table.

activities.name: Solar Oven Temperature Trials
activities.tagline: Teens build box solar ovens and trial them like scientists: one variable at a time, temperatures logged by the minute, the sun as the only power source.

activities.name: Growing Degree-Day Ledger
activities.tagline: Teens keep a season's heat accounts: daily temperatures become growing degree-days, a budburst prediction is written down, and the plants grade it.

activities.name: Microclimate Map Survey
activities.tagline: Teens read temperature, shade and wind at a grid of stations in one place at one hour, and draw the map of its many small climates.

activities.name: Kin-Ball First Session
activities.tagline: A three-team game played with one enormous ball: serve by calling a colour, keep the ball off your ground, and win by being hardest to catch out.

activities.name: Conducting Patterns Studio
activities.tagline: Teens learn to lead music with their hands: beat patterns in two, three and four, clear cueing, and a room that starts and stops together.

activities.name: One-Table Micro Museum
activities.tagline: On a rainy day, teen curators build a real museum on one table: objects on loan from their owners, honest labels, and one argument made of things.

activities.name: Sashiko Stitch Sampler Studio
activities.tagline: Teens learn sashiko's running stitch, counted rows of small, even stitches through cloth, and build a sampler of traditional geometric patterns.

activities.name: Personal Map Introductions
activities.tagline: New teens draw a map of the places that made them, real, remembered, or hoped for, and introduce themselves by giving the room a tour.

activities.name: Celtic Knot Drawing Studio
activities.tagline: For St. Patrick's Day, teens draw true Celtic knots on a dot grid: one unbroken line woven over and under itself, checked crossing by crossing.

activities.name: First Rounds: Singing in Canon
activities.tagline: One song, many starting lines: the group learns to sing the same tune at different times and hears it turn into harmony.

activities.name: Ostinato Layer Band
activities.tagline: Build a whole song out of stubborn little patterns: each crew owns one repeating layer, and the layers stack into music.

activities.name: Tempo Parade: Turtle Slow, Cheetah Fast
activities.tagline: A drum sets the speed and little bodies learn it: creep like a turtle, scurry like a cheetah, and stop when the beat stops.

activities.name: Domino Rally Design Studio
activities.tagline: One tile falls and tells the next: design a run with curves, splits and a finale, then earn the single push that sets it off.

activities.name: Sock Bocce: Indoor Court League
activities.tagline: The ancient lawn game moves indoors: soft sock balls, a hallway court, and points for whoever rests closest to the little ball.

activities.name: Cup Anemometer Wind Lab
activities.tagline: Build the weather station's spinning cups, count the turns, and turn a summer week of breezes into numbers you can argue with.

activities.name: Rainbow Flower Capillary Lab
activities.tagline: White flowers drink coloured water and keep the receipt: watch a stem pull colour up into the petals, hour by hour.

activities.name: Floating Lights: A Diwali Diya Bowl
activities.tagline: For the festival of lights, a bowl of water carries the lights: LED diyas floated among petals, glowing without a single flame.

activities.name: Kickball
activities.tagline: Baseball's playground cousin: one big ball, pitched slow, kicked far, and run like the bases are on fire.

activities.name: Four Square
activities.tagline: Four chalk squares, one ball, and a line of challengers waiting to climb to the top court.

activities.name: Sharks and Minnows
activities.tagline: One shark in the middle of the pool, a wall of minnows at the edge, and a crossing nobody wants to rush.

activities.name: Marco Polo
activities.tagline: Eyes closed in the pool: one voice calls 'Marco' and every splash answers 'Polo'.

activities.name: Hot Potato
activities.tagline: A beanbag too hot to hold: pass it fast, pass it kind, and never be holding it when the music stops.

activities.name: Pass the Parcel
activities.tagline: A prize wrapped in a dozen layers, passed to the music: every stop unwraps somebody's layer.

activities.name: Follow the Leader
activities.tagline: One leader, one winding line, and every hop, spin, and silly walk copied all the way down.

activities.name: Mother, May I?
activities.tagline: Ask politely, move cleverly: giant steps, baby steps, and a leader who loves to answer 'no, but you may instead'.

activities.name: What's the Time, Mr Wolf?
activities.tagline: 'Three o'clock' means three brave steps closer. 'Dinner time' means run for the line.

activities.name: Sardines
activities.tagline: Hide and seek turned inside out: one player hides, everyone hunts, and the hiding spot slowly fills with sardines.

activities.name: Kick the Can
activities.tagline: One can, one jail, and a whole ground full of hiders: kick the can and everybody runs free.

activities.name: Egg-and-Spoon Race
activities.tagline: A spoon, a wobbling egg, and a finish line that punishes every hurried step.

activities.name: Sack Race
activities.tagline: Both legs in one burlap sack: the field day race where the fastest runners become beginners again.

activities.name: Three-Legged Race
activities.tagline: Two racers, three legs, one rhythm: 'inside, outside' all the way to the finish line.

activities.name: Wheelbarrow Race
activities.tagline: One partner walks on their hands while the other steers by the ankles: the race that empties every arm in the field.

activities.name: Gaga Ball
activities.tagline: Inside the pit the ball stays low and the hits stay kind: last player standing takes the round.

activities.name: 9 Square in the Air
activities.tagline: A court in the air on a nine-square frame: one hit per square, and the middle square is the throne.

activities.name: Cornhole
activities.tagline: Two boards, eight bags, and the sweetest three points in the yard: a bag clean through the hole.

activities.name: Tie-Dye Shirts
activities.tagline: Twist it, band it, drown it in colour: no two shirts ever come out of the bucket alike.

activities.name: Chess, First Session
activities.tagline: Sixteen pieces, six kinds of moves, one quiet hour: the first game, taught so it never feels like a test.

activities.name: Dominoes, First Game
activities.tagline: Match the dots and empty your hand: the draw game that teaches counting without ever saying so.

activities.name: Go Fish
activities.tagline: 'Do you have any sevens?' The first card game every child learns, and still the best way to teach asking.

activities.name: Kids Yoga, First Session
activities.tagline: Animal poses, slow breaths, and a room that settles itself: a first yoga session built for wiggly bodies.
